title: Innovation Centers — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: WCBT encourages students to test ideas, build prototypes, collaborate with mentors, and connect learning to local needs.

blocks.heading: How the center supports students
paras: Innovation activities bring together faculty guidance, industry input, project work, and entrepreneurial thinking.

groups.title: Idea Development
text: Students learn how to identify problems, shape ideas, and define useful solutions.

groups.title: Applied Projects
text: Project work turns classroom knowledge into prototypes, demos, and experiments.

groups.title: Team Collaboration
text: Students practice communication, planning, and delivery through group innovation work.

groups.title: Mentor Support
text: Faculty and industry mentors guide students through technical and practical decisions.

groups.title: Startup Thinking
text: Activities introduce students to entrepreneurship, validation, pitching, and iteration.

blocks.heading: Explore student innovation
paras: Learn how WCBT connects research, projects, and industry exposure.
